fuel_consumption.source_quote: Based on our annual fuel consumption, a 10% increase in the average price per gallon of aircraft fuel would have increased into-plane aircraft fuel cost for 2013 by approximately $54.3 million.

instrument_type_details.notes: As of December 31, 2013, no derivative contracts outstanding. Filing references prior-year FV of Dec 31, 2012 ($0.3M net liability). Describes program capability but no active positions.

throughput.source_quote: Fuel gallons consumed 171,931 [2013] 142,991 [2012] [from 2013 Annual Report operating statistics table, in thousands]; Aircraft fuel expense increased by 17% from $471.8 million in 2012 to $551.7 million in 2013, due to a 20.2% increase in fuel gallons consumed.

warnings: No contracts outstanding at year-end 2013; company still describes hedging capability; resumed hedging in 2014
